note: Coupling reaction: benzenediazonium chloride (ring-N(+)#N with a separate Cl- ) + phenol, drawn with the para H written out as 'H-' on the ring to mark the coupling position, over an arrow carrying (-)OH, giving p-Hydroxyazobenzene (orange dye) + Cl- + H2O. The azo linkage is drawn as a straight horizontal -N=N- between the two rings, which does not fix the geometry about the N=N bond, so no E/Z is written. (-)OH is the reagent over the arrow and is placed in the agents field.
